params.prompt: macOS app icon for an app called Glowbeat, a Mac app that makes smart light bulbs pulse to music. Apple macOS Sonoma icon style: a single rounded-square (squircle) tile with soft top-lit glassy gradient, subtle inner shadow, centered on a plain solid dark gray background with nothing else, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, front view, ultra clean vector-like rendering, high detail. The tile is a dark graphite gradient. Inside: a light bulb silhouette made of five vertical glowing equalizer bars in a rainbow gradient from red to violet, bars of different heights forming the bulb shape, glossy.
